Signals citing this source

  • UK AI Security Institute, F (for): Taxpayer funded; no commercial relationship with labs.
  • UK AI Security Institute, X (for): No commercial products.
  • UK AI Security Institute, F (against): AISI administers the Alignment Project, a GBP 27m grant pool that includes GBP 5.6m from OpenAI and money from Anthropic, Microsoft and AWS; core budget of about GBP 66m per year is public.
  • UK AI Security Institute, P (for): AISI staff are civil servants in DSIT and are bound by the Civil Service Code (conflicts and gifts) and the Business Appointment Rules, a statutory post-employment rule that applies for one to two years after leaving Crown service.
